title: Admin connections form — field missing/changed due to SSOT config drift (e.g. acquirer_merchant_id)
symptom: Admin connection configuration tests fail with a UI element timeout (e.g. 'acquirer_merchant_id' input not visible after ~40s) while editing or creating a PSP connection's 3DS/config info. The expected input field for the connection form never renders, blocking the test from completing the PSP setup step. Tends to affect multiple connection-related test cases at once across different PSPs (MercadoPago, Prosa, generic 3DS) in the same regression.
recipe: Do NOT treat this as a selector bug and do NOT propose a new locator. The admin connections form is driven by SSOT (the system that defines which fields the form renders for a given connection/PSP). When a field is added or removed on the SSOT side, Playwright sees the field as missing (or an unexpected field appears) and times out waiting for it. This is a backend/config issue, not an e2e or selector defect: flag for serviceInvestigator / SSOT owners to confirm the field definition is in sync, and update the SSOT config (add back or align the missing field, e.g. acquirer_merchant_id) for the affected PSP/connection. Only revisit the test/page-object if SSOT is confirmed correct and the e2e selector itself is stale.
